# Reorg-safe indexer

> An Ethereum mainnet log indexer in TypeScript and Postgres. It writes one transaction per block range, finds reorganisations by parent hash and rolls them back, and serves a range only after seven SQL quality gates and a check against a second provider. This site is its read-only dashboard; the figures load in the browser, so the pages hold little text. The full description is in the repository README.

Seven days live (17 to 24 October 2026): 41 real reorganisations handled, all one block deep and rolled back with no halt; head lag p95 of 0 blocks; no gaps below the finalized block; no unexplained mismatch against the second provider. The README and docs/costs-and-load.md give the window and the checks.

## Dashboard

- [Overview](https://indexer.ubaidillah.id/): where the indexer is relative to the chain, what has been published, and what went wrong most recently
- [Reorgs](https://indexer.ubaidillah.id/reorgs): every detected chain reorganisation, newest first
- [Data quality](https://indexer.ubaidillah.id/quality): a range is published only when every block is finalized and every data-quality gate passed; failed ranges stay unpublished and queue a backfill job
- [Reconciliation](https://indexer.ubaidillah.id/reconciliation): finalized ranges re-read from a second provider
- [Explorer](https://indexer.ubaidillah.id/explorer): decoded ERC-20 transfers and Uniswap v3 swaps from published ranges, newest first
- [Analytics](https://indexer.ubaidillah.id/analytics): daily volume, active addresses and pool prices from the Parquet export of published ranges
